In [[6 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> a '''naval yard''' was located on the astronomical object [[Lozash]]. Utilized by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy]], the yard contained assets belonging to the [[Navy|naval]] branch, such as [[Imperial masking device]]s for [[starship]]s. In that [[Standard year|year]], the naval yard was infiltrated by the [[Anto Kreegyr's group|rebel group]] led by [[Anto Kreegyr]], who stole one such masking device from the Empire. A year later,<ref name="Nobody's Listening!" /> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the device was utilized by a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr|rebel pilot]] from Kreegyr's group aboard a [[GPE 7000 transport]], but the pilot was eventually captured by the Empire while traveling to the [[Ring of Kafrene]]<ref name="Nobody's Listening!" /> in the [[Expansion Region]].<ref name="RO World Locations">{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-rogue-one|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Rogue One''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Rogue One?}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lozash naval yard was mentioned in "[[Nobody's Listening!]],"<ref name="Nobody's Listening!" /> the ninth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' television series's [[Andor Season 1|first season]],<ref name="Disney Media">{{Disney|subdomain=dmedmedia|url=disney-plus/andor|text=Andor Media Kit}}</ref> which aired on [[November 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
